question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vigorous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vigorous"** means strong, healthy, and full of energy. (जोशपूर्ण, ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example: **He gave a vigorous performance that left the audience in awe.
 
 

 
• **"Energetic" **refers to having or showing a lot of energy; lively and active. (ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example: **The kids were energetic after the long recess.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Vigorous' **is **'Energetic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Academic **(शैक्षणिक): Relating to education and scholarship.
 
 
• **Example:** His academic achievements have been recognized worldwide.
 
 

 
• **Guarded **(सतर्क): Cautious and having reservations.
 
 
• **Example: **She gave a guarded response to the sensitive question.
 
 

 
• **Furious** (क्रोधित): Extremely angry.
 
 
• **Example:** He was furious when he found out the truth.

The correct answer is** option 3.**</p&g
